facts: The named tower was restored in 1933 by Alexander Rashenov based on a medieval tower at the Cherven fortress. The curtain along the rocky citadel ridge is approximately 2.4 m thick, rising to 3.6 m at some points.

record: Veliko Tarnovo Regional Museum, archaeological field report
facts: The restoration incorporates masonry of the medieval Bulgarian curtain over earlier Byzantine-period foundations.

record: Mapped stone tower and city wall position
facts: The nearly rectangular tower footprint is about 6.95 by 7.78 m. It occupies the southern corner of the mapped wall circuit.
